ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Reference-view adapter for identity anchoring in native image-to-3D generation
PROPOSAL: Fine-tune a rank-16 LoRA on TRELLIS using the single input image plus 8 views synthesized by a DreamBooth-tuned SDXL model, then generate the asset and render its side and back views. Evaluate on 40 Objaverse subjects with held-out ground-truth renders, reporting DINO and CLIP image similarity and LPIPS per viewpoint with 5 seeds on every comparison.
CONTROLS: Untouched TRELLIS; Hunyuan3D-2 without adaptation; a LoRA trained on the input image alone; a multi-view diffusion pipeline that reconstructs from 6 generated views.
COST: 120
PREDICTION: Side and back views should gain about 0.06 DINO similarity over untouched TRELLIS, with smaller gains elsewhere. It could fail if the synthesized views carry the same color bias as the generator and reinforce it.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Score-distillation refinement of Hunyuan3D-2 outputs with a personalized SDXL prior
PROPOSAL: Generate the asset with Hunyuan3D-2, then refine its texture for 3000 steps with a DreamBooth-tuned SDXL prior built from the input image, rendering the side and back views for the loss. Evaluate on 40 Objaverse subjects with held-out ground-truth renders, repeating refinement for 4 guidance scales, reporting DINO and CLIP image similarity and LPIPS per viewpoint with 3 seeds.
CONTROLS: Unrefined Hunyuan3D-2 output; refinement using the unpersonalized SDXL prior; refinement with a prior tuned for fewer steps; a native generator baseline using the TRELLIS model.
COST: 120
PREDICTION: Refinement should raise back-view DINO similarity by about 0.05 and the front view by less, and the best guidance scale near the middle of the range. It could fail if the prior over-saturates color and trades identity for sharpness.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Identity-weighted adaptation of a video-to-4D generator on a cat-video benchmark
PROPOSAL: Fine-tune SV4D 2.0 with a rank-16 LoRA and a per-frame identity loss computed from DINOv2 features of the input video frames, then render the generated asset from side and back cameras. Evaluate on 30 Consistent4D videos, reporting DINO and CLIP image similarity, LPIPS per viewpoint and temporal flicker with 3 seeds.
CONTROLS: Unadapted SV4D 2.0; a LoRA trained with the standard reconstruction loss only; a 4D pipeline that animates a static asset from the first frame; DreamGaussian4D as an optimization-based reference.
COST: 400
PREDICTION: The identity loss should lift back-view DINO similarity by about 0.05 and leave flicker unchanged. It could fail if the loss locks appearance to the first frame and harms motion fidelity.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Joint study of identity adaptation for image-to-3D and video-to-4D generation
PROPOSAL: Fine-tune TRELLIS on single images and SV4D 2.0 on single videos with a rank-16 LoRA and a feature loss computed from DINOv2 features of the input, then render the assets from side and back cameras. Evaluate on 30 Objaverse subjects and 30 Consistent4D videos, reporting DINO and CLIP image similarity, LPIPS per viewpoint and temporal flicker with 3 seeds.
CONTROLS: Unadapted TRELLIS and SV4D 2.0; LoRAs trained with the standard reconstruction loss only; a 4D pipeline that animates a static asset from the first frame; one shared LoRA for both.
COST: 400
PREDICTION: Both generators should gain about 0.05 back-view DINO similarity, with the 4D gain smaller. It may fail if one shared recipe fits the image generator but disrupts temporal consistency.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Appearance-token correction of color drift in multi-view diffusion for subject-driven 3D
PROPOSAL: Learn a subject token at 2 learning rates within the text encoder of MVDream from 4 views rendered out of the input image, and add a color-statistics loss that matches hue histograms with 16 bins of generated novel views to those of the input image. Reconstruct with LGM, and report on 40 Objaverse subjects and 20 photographed pets, with hue shift, DINO similarity and LPIPS for side and back views with 3 seeds.
CONTROLS: MVDream with no token; the token without the color loss; Zero123++ conditioned on the input image alone; TRELLIS without adaptation.
COST: 900
PREDICTION: Hue shift on back views should fall by about a third, with DINO similarity up by 0.04. The token might fail if a few input views fix the pose of the subject and the model memorizes one view.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Large-model personalization of multi-view diffusion with Stable Video 3D and a feature-matching loss
PROPOSAL: Fine-tune Stable Video 3D with a rank-64 LoRA and a DINOv2 feature-matching loss on the input image, then reconstruct the asset with LGM in a single pass and render front, side and back views. Evaluate on 40 Objaverse subjects and 10 photographed objects, repeating training for several LoRA ranks, reporting hue shift, DINO similarity and LPIPS for each view with 5 seeds.
CONTROLS: Stable Video 3D with no adaptation; a LoRA trained without the feature loss; Zero123++ conditioned on the input image alone; the TRELLIS model without adaptation.
COST: 900
PREDICTION: The larger LoRA ranks should cut hue shift on back views by about a third, while ranks beyond the middle add little. It might fail if the loss pulls generated views toward the pose of the reference.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Identity-paired training set and adapter for a native 3D generator
PROPOSAL: Build 20000 subject sets from Objaverse, each pairing one reference render with 12 novel-view renders under varied lighting, and train an identity-conditioned adapter on TRELLIS with a DINOv2 feature loss on novel views. Evaluate on 100 held-out subjects with ground-truth renders and 20 photographed objects, and report DINO and CLIP similarity and LPIPS for side and back views with 5 seeds.
CONTROLS: Untouched TRELLIS; a per-subject LoRA tuned at inference time; an adapter trained without the feature loss; Hunyuan3D-2 as an independent native generator.
COST: 2500
PREDICTION: The adapter should match per-subject tuning on side views within 0.02 DINO similarity while generating in a single pass. It might fail if the paired training subjects are too synthetic to transfer to photographed objects.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Loss-term and view-count ablations of identity-aware multi-view generation
PROPOSAL: Fine-tune Zero123++ as a multi-view model with identity-aware optimization using a DINOv2 feature loss, a color loss and a view-consistency loss, on 12 Objaverse subjects with ground-truth renders. Train with 4 loss weightings and 3 view counts and 3 seeds, reporting DINO and CLIP similarity and LPIPS for side and back views together with how identity score correlates with view count.
CONTROLS: Untouched Zero123++; single-loss variants that drop one term each; an inference-time LoRA baseline; TRELLIS as an independent generator.
COST: 2500
PREDICTION: The feature loss should account for most of the gain, around 0.05 DINO similarity, while the view-consistency term adds little. It may fail if 12 subjects are too few to separate loss weightings from seed noise.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Learned subject token as conditioning for multi-view generation from one image
PROPOSAL: Learn a single subject token in the text encoder of MVDream from 4 views rendered out of the input image, then generate 4 views and reconstruct the asset with LGM. Evaluate on 36 Objaverse subjects and 15 real-world scans with held-out views, reporting DINO and CLIP image similarity and LPIPS for side and back views with 5 seeds.
CONTROLS: MVDream with a generic caption; Zero123++ conditioned on the input image alone; a token learned from the front view only; TRELLIS without adaptation.
COST: 250
PREDICTION: The token should raise side-view DINO similarity by about 0.03, mostly for subjects with distinctive patterns. It could fail if the token encodes the background of the reference renders instead of the subject.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Token-count and learning-rate sweep for subject conditioning in multi-view diffusion
PROPOSAL: Learn from 1 to 8 subject tokens in the text encoder of MVDream from 4 views rendered out of the input image, trained with 5 learning rates, then generate views and reconstruct with LGM. Evaluate on 12 Objaverse subjects with held-out views, reporting DINO and CLIP image similarity and LPIPS for side and back views with 3 seeds.
CONTROLS: MVDream with a generic caption; Zero123++ conditioned on the input image alone; tokens learned with an SDXL-sized encoder; the best setting evaluated with TRELLIS reconstruction.
COST: 250
PREDICTION: Two tokens should give the best identity score, with gains of about 0.03 DINO similarity falling off as the count grows. It might fail if the ordering among learning rates changes from subject to subject.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Temporal identity loss for video-to-4D generation on animal videos
PROPOSAL: Fine-tune SV4D 2.0 with a rank-32 LoRA and a loss that matches DINOv2 features of generated side and back renders to those of the input frames across time. Evaluate on 30 Consistent4D videos with 3 seeds, reporting DINO and CLIP image similarity, LPIPS per viewpoint, flicker, and a rating study with 12 raters on 20 videos.
CONTROLS: Unadapted SV4D 2.0; a LoRA trained with a reconstruction loss only; an identity loss applied to the first frame only; DreamGaussian4D as an optimization-based reference.
COST: 1500
PREDICTION: The temporal loss should raise back-view DINO similarity by about 0.05 and win the rating study on most videos. It could fail if matching features over time suppresses legitimate pose-dependent appearance changes.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Identity-preserving video-to-4D on animals with 3 adapter sizes and 2 guidance modes
PROPOSAL: Fine-tune SV4D 2.0 with LoRA ranks of 8, 32 and 128, and a loss that matches DINOv2 features of generated side and back renders to those of the input frames across time, adding SDXL guidance in half of the runs. Evaluate on 45 Consistent4D videos with 3 seeds, reporting DINO and CLIP image similarity, LPIPS and flicker.
CONTROLS: Unadapted SV4D 2.0; LoRAs trained with a reconstruction loss only; an identity loss applied to the first frame only; DreamGaussian4D as an optimization-based reference; runs without SDXL guidance.
COST: 1500
PREDICTION: The temporal loss should raise back-view DINO similarity by about 0.05, with rank 32 and rank 128 within 0.01. It might fail if the guidance pulls appearance toward the SDXL data distribution and cancels the loss gain.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Two-stage pipeline: native coarse shape then reference-guided multi-view re-texturing
PROPOSAL: Generate a coarse shape with Hunyuan3D-2, then re-texture it with a multi-view diffusion model conditioned on the input image, 6 reference views from a DreamBooth-tuned SDXL prior and a reference-attention layer that copies appearance from the input to side and back views. Evaluate on 40 Objaverse subjects and 20 photographed objects with held-out views, reporting DINO and CLIP similarity and LPIPS per viewpoint with 3 seeds.
CONTROLS: The Hunyuan3D-2 texture as generated; re-texturing without reference attention; TRELLIS as an independent native generator; a LoRA tuned on the input image alone.
COST: 700
PREDICTION: Re-texturing should add about 0.05 DINO similarity on back views and cost little on the front. It might fail if the reference attention leaks the input lighting into the generated views.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: High-resolution score-distillation re-texturing of Hunyuan3D-2 shapes under a personalized prior
PROPOSAL: Generate a shape with Hunyuan3D-2, then re-texture it at 1024-pixel renders with a DreamBooth-tuned SDXL prior, optimizing for 5000 steps with front, side and back cameras sampled at random. Evaluate on 20 Objaverse subjects with held-out views, repeating the optimization for several guidance weights, and report DINO and CLIP similarity and LPIPS per viewpoint with 5 seeds.
CONTROLS: The Hunyuan3D-2 texture as generated; re-texturing under an unpersonalized SDXL prior; a run at lower resolution; a LoRA tuned on the input image alone.
COST: 700
PREDICTION: High-resolution runs should add about 0.02 DINO similarity over lower-resolution runs and match the reference-attention gains on back views. It could fail if optimization noise exceeds this difference between seeds.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Identity-aware fine-tuning of a multi-view diffusion model on paired captions and renders
PROPOSAL: Fine-tune MVDream on 60000 Objaverse subject sets, each with a reference render, 8 novel views and a subject-specific caption, using a DINOv2 feature loss on the novel views and identity-weighted sampling. Evaluate on 100 held-out subjects and 32 real-world scans, reporting DINO and CLIP similarity and LPIPS for side and back views with 5 seeds.
CONTROLS: Untouched MVDream; a per-subject LoRA tuned at inference time; training without the feature loss; Zero123++ as an independent multi-view baseline.
COST: 3000
PREDICTION: The tuned model should reach per-subject LoRA quality within 0.02 DINO similarity in a single pass. It could fail if caption diversity is too narrow, so identity cues are learned from text rather than from the reference.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Adapter-size study of identity-aware multi-view generation with 3 loss mixtures
PROPOSAL: Train identity adapters of 3 sizes on MVDream as a multi-view generator with 3 loss mixtures, using a DINOv2 feature loss on novel views, a hue-histogram loss and a view-consistency loss on 5000 Objaverse subject sets. Evaluate on 100 held-out subjects, reporting DINO and CLIP similarity and LPIPS for side and back views with 3 seeds, along with the relation between adapter size and identity score.
CONTROLS: Untouched MVDream; a per-subject LoRA tuned at inference time; single-loss mixtures; Zero123++ as an independent multi-view baseline; the smallest adapter trained longer.
COST: 3000
PREDICTION: Identity score should grow with adapter size up to the middle size, by about 0.04 DINO similarity, then flatten. It could fail if the 5000 training sets are too few to feed the larger adapters.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Checking whether embedding similarity tracks human identity ratings of 3D assets
PROPOSAL: Collect identity ratings from 15 raters on side and back renders of assets from 3 methods (TRELLIS, Hunyuan3D-2, MVDream plus LGM) for 24 Objaverse subjects, then correlate ratings with DINO similarity, CLIP image similarity and LPIPS to the ground-truth renders. Report rank correlations per viewpoint with bootstrap intervals over subjects, and test whether the best metric separates the methods in the order the raters do.
CONTROLS: A random-score baseline; correlation computed on front views only; a color-histogram distance as an alternative metric; rater agreement measured on a repeated subset.
COST: 180
PREDICTION: DINO similarity should show a rank correlation near 0.7 with the ratings, above LPIPS by about 0.2. It could fail if raters weigh shape over color, so metrics tuned to texture correlate weakly.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Metric-validation study with 5 embedding metrics on renders of TRELLIS assets
PROPOSAL: Render side and back views of TRELLIS assets for 24 Objaverse subjects under 5 camera elevations and 4 lighting settings, then correlate DINO similarity, CLIP image similarity, LPIPS, SSIM and a color-histogram distance with a held-out reference using 12 raters. Report rank correlations per viewpoint and per elevation with bootstrap intervals over subjects, and test whether the best metric orders the settings as the raters do.
CONTROLS: A random-score baseline; correlation computed on front views only; each metric recomputed on grayscale renders; rater agreement measured on a repeated subset.
COST: 180
PREDICTION: DINO similarity should show a rank correlation near 0.7 with the ratings, above SSIM by about 0.3. It could fail if raters react to lighting differences that the embedding metrics ignore.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Measuring color drift in side and back views across four generation pipelines
PROPOSAL: Generate assets from 60 Objaverse subjects with TRELLIS, Hunyuan3D-2, a multi-view diffusion pipeline using MVDream plus LGM, and SV4D 2.0 on turntable videos, then measure the hue and saturation shift of side and back renders against ground-truth renders. Report shifts per viewpoint and per pipeline with 3 seeds, and relate them to DINO similarity.
CONTROLS: Front-view shift as a zero reference; a mean-color correction applied after generation; a gray-world white-balance baseline; shifts computed on renders of ground-truth meshes with reconstructed textures.
COST: 500
PREDICTION: Multi-view diffusion pipelines should show the largest hue shift, near 12 degrees on back views, and TRELLIS the smallest. It could fail if the shift is dominated by renderer lighting rather than by the generators.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Color drift in side and back views and its correction by a post-hoc color head
PROPOSAL: Generate assets from 60 Objaverse subjects with TRELLIS, Hunyuan3D-2, a multi-view diffusion pipeline using MVDream plus LGM, and SV4D 2.0, then measure the hue and saturation shift of side and back renders against ground-truth renders. Report shifts per viewpoint and per pipeline with 3 seeds, train a small color head on 20 of the subjects, and relate corrected shifts to DINO similarity.
CONTROLS: Front-view shift as a zero reference; a mean-color correction applied after generation; a gray-world white-balance baseline; the color head trained on 5 subjects only.
COST: 500
PREDICTION: The color head should remove about half of the hue shift on back views and add about 0.02 DINO similarity. It may fail if drift depends on texture and not on global color, so a global head cannot fix it.
